opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you go. Scout a playground in VR and send her one short video.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A city park belongs to the whole town. If something there breaks, citizens can ask the city council, the group voters elect to make the city's rules.

place.alt: Colorful market stalls with bright painted walls
place.html: Everyone shares a community: neighbors from many countries use the same parks and streets.
place.cap: The Haitian Market in Little Haiti, Miami, 2020. Library of Congress.

say: If something here broke, I would ask the ___ for help by ___.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the playground
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Look at everything kids use here. Pick one thing that would need fixing if it broke.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit that thing in the tablet. Click Record video, say your 2 sentences, and click it again to stop.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new video.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Point the camera at that thing while you say your second sentence.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, showing the place while you say both sentences.

studio.title: Citizen Choices
studio.look: Four real Florida problems. Each one has three choices. One choice works with government to fix the problem.
studio.do: Read the story. Tap the choice a good citizen would make.

game.miss: Think again. Does that choice help fix the problem?
game.done: The meter is full! See a problem, take action, and bring it to the right government.

rounds.scene: Plastic straws and foam boxes keep ending up as litter.
options: Complain to friends and do nothing.
Ask the City Council to cut down on plastic straws.
Wait for someone else to notice.
rounds.ok: Yes! In 2018 the council voted to cut down on straws and foam.

rounds.scene: Parents and teachers are worried about safety at school.
options: Go to a school board meeting and speak up.
rounds.ok: Yes! The school board runs the county's public schools.
miss: That doesn't reach the people who decide.

rounds.scene: People want more parks and wild land.
options: Voted yes on a small sales tax for parks.
rounds.ok: Yes! Voters said yes in 2008, 2016 and 2022.
miss: Nice, but it doesn't make parks.

options: Went to a town hall meeting and asked officials for help.
rounds.ok: Yes! They asked state and national officials for help.
miss: Officials can't help if they don't know.

frames.starter: One problem in my community is ...

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
